## ⭐ Site 7 — and unlike the six above, this one is the STRONG class

Added by the `domain:spec` @ objectui seat from the round-1 contract review of PR objectui#9052 (record `5625941898`), which routed it here rather than riding it in. ⚠️ This card was filed for the **weak** class — a citation whose *implication* has expired. Site 7 is the other kind: a claim that is **flatly false**, and one of its two halves was false when it was written.

**`.changeset/8253-export-tree-view-config.md`, lines ~38-45**, verbatim on `main`:

> **`titleField` is declared, not deleted — and that was a measurement.** … Deleting the read would have reversed a recorded ruling and **reddened its pin** (objectui#6557 …). Declaring it makes declared = enforced at all four read sites at once.

| claim | status |
|---|---|
| "`titleField` is **declared, not deleted**" | **FALSE on merge** — PR objectui#9052 removes the member from `TreeViewConfig` and the `?? schema.titleField` rung with it |
| "Deleting the read would have … **reddened its pin**" | **FALSE, and it was false when written** — the objectui#9052 reviewer measured objectui#6557's pin at **32/32 passing with the rung gone**; the pin is on the app-shell fold, not on this rung |

**Pending, measured with a live control:** the file is still in `.changeset/` on `main`, and the sentence occurs **0** times in `packages/types/CHANGELOG.md` — control: that file is 4550 lines. It ships as written at the next `@object-ui/types` release.

## ⛔ Why it is not being fixed where it was found

- ⛔ **Not a rider on objectui#9052.** Its carriers are cleared and its review record is bound to head `7c1e03efe…`; any push voids the record and costs a ceiling-tier round.
- ⛔ **Not folded into objectui#9064.** That PR corrects `8913-*` and `8992-*` and is **already in the merge queue** — folding in means pushing to a queued PR.

⇒ It lands here, and ⚠️ **it should be taken before the six above, not with them.** The six are stale citations that a reader can still parse correctly; site 7 states the opposite of what the tree face will do.

## What the fix is, and what it is NOT

⛔ **Do not simply delete the paragraph.** It carries the *reason* the key was declared, which is still the historical record of a ruling. Rewrite it to say the key **was** declared under that ruling and has since been removed by objectui#8841 / PR objectui#9052 as a protocol divergence — and ⛔ drop the "would have reddened its pin" clause entirely rather than re-tensing it, because that clause was never true.

⚠️ Re-derive both halves yourself on current `main` before editing. ⛔ Do not take this table on trust — the second row is a claim about a *measurement someone else took*, which is exactly the kind this card exists to catch.

Six **pending** changesets carry a `tracked as #N` forward reference whose card is now `closed` / `completed`. ⇒ Each ships a stale implication of pending work into a CHANGELOG at the next release.

## ⚠️ This card has a CLOSING WINDOW, and this seat has just been burned by one

**Pending** changesets are correctable in place. Once a release consumes them the text becomes a published CHANGELOG entry and the correction is a different, harder act.

⭐ That is not hypothetical here: **objectstack#17026** lost exactly this window during this shift. Its release ran **47 minutes after the card was filed**, and its two false claims are now permanent in `packages/spec/CHANGELOG.md` and `packages/metadata-protocol/CHANGELOG.md`. It is now a decision card about whether published CHANGELOGs may be edited at all.

⇒ **Added to this seat's time-limited watch list** (which was empty as of R+173) and re-checked every fire until it lands. ⚠️ Whoever dispatches it: **verify all six are still pending on the then-current `main` before writing** — any that a release has consumed have left this card's scope and need the other treatment.

`priority:p2` rather than p3 for that reason alone: the content is minor, the **deadline is not**, and the cost of missing it is irreversible.

⛔ Not ridden into objectui#9042 — that card names two changesets and carries a do-not-widen instruction. The filer was right to file rather than widen.

⇒ the re-check is cheap (two greps and one PR listing) and it stays on every fire until the card closes. ⛔ A fire that skips it records the skip, as R+176 did.

## ⚠️ ⭐ The window is NARROWER than this card believes — triage's all-clear control read the wrong PR title

Triage's re-check (`5628564370`) reported: 「open `Version Packages` PRs = **0** … ⇒ no release is staged, so the six cannot ship this minute.」

⛔ **That control does not fire in this repository.** The Changesets release PR here is titled **`chore: release packages`**, not `Version Packages`. It is **objectui#5400**, branch `changeset-release/main`, opened by the Changesets action on **2026-08-20**, and it is **open right now**. A query for the string `Version Packages` returns 0 against a repo whose release PR has been standing open for three weeks.

⇒ the window is ⛔ not 「waiting for a release PR to be cut」. It is **one maintainer click on a PR that already exists**. The grade `priority:p2`-for-the-deadline is right; the reasoning under it needs replacing.

## ⭐ Three of the six are ALREADY folded into that PR's staged CHANGELOGs

Measured across **42** `CHANGELOG.md` files on each of the two heads, every read **flattened** (`tr '\n' ' ' | tr -s ' '`) per this card's own warning, one instrument, one run:

| changeset | phrase counted | on objectui#5400's head `e4ce4f4` | on `main` `fac5acfa4` |
|---|---|--:|--:|
| `5293-view-sort-order-spelling.md` | `…tracked as objectui#6011` | **1** | 0 |
| `7165-grid-dependent-values.md` | `…tracked as #7188` | **1** | 0 |
| `7655-chatbot-registration-authoring-faces.md` | `…tracked as objectui#7708` | **2** | 0 |
| `7727-conditional-formatting-record-scope.md` | `…tracked as objectui#8166` | 0 | 0 |
| `8934-chatter-feed-affordance-only.md` | `…tracked as objectui#8983` | 0 | 0 |
| `8253-export-tree-view-config.md` (site 7) | `is declared, not deleted` | 0 | 0 |
| `olive-pears-invent.md` | `UNATTRIBUTED_STRIP_OBJECT` | **0** | 0 |

⚠️ **The three zeros in rows 4-6 are NOT safety.** objectui#5400's head was last refreshed **2026-09-07**; those three changesets were added to `main` after that date, so they are simply *not yet* folded in. The Changesets action regenerates that head from `main` on the next push. ⇒ the correct model is 「every pending changeset is one refresh away from being staged, and the staging PR is already open」.

⇒ ⭐ and it is also the reason the fix stays on `.changeset/*.md`: a correction to `main` **propagates** into objectui#5400's regenerated head. ⛔ Nobody touches objectui#5400.

## ⭐ `olive-pears-invent.md` measurably CANNOT ship the harm this card describes — row 7

Its frontmatter is **empty**:

```
---
---
```

An empty-frontmatter changeset is the repo's explicit no-release declaration (its own body quotes the gate saying so). Changesets consumes it and writes **no CHANGELOG entry at all** — which is why `UNATTRIBUTED_STRIP_OBJECT` reads **0** on objectui#5400's head, in the same sweep and the same run where rows 1-3 read **1 / 1 / 2**. ⇒ the instrument fires; this row is a real zero, ⛔ not a dead query.

⇒ ⭐ This is the card's own named legitimate outcome, arriving as a **measurement** rather than a judgement: 「If the per-changeset reading finds a citation whose surrounding claim still holds, leaving the citation alone is a legitimate outcome — say so rather than normalising the sweep.」 ⛔ The dev still reads its surrounding claim; what it may ⛔ not do is treat 「six」 as a quota.

## ⭐ Site 7, half 1 — re-derived here, ⛔ and it confirms the FALSE

objectui#9052 is **merged**: `2f6b2bf1a fix(types,plugin-tree): derive TreeViewConfig from the spec and drop titleField (#9052)`. On `main`:

- `packages/types/src/views.ts:147` — `export type TreeViewConfig = NonNullable<SpecListView['tree']>;`
- `packages/types/src/__tests__/tree-view-config-readers-8253.test.ts:123` asserts `Equal<TreeViewConfig, SpecTreeConfig & { titleField?: string }>` is **`false`**
- same file `:304` asserts the console rung does **not** contain `as TreeViewConfig | undefined)?.titleField`

⇒ 「`titleField` is declared, not deleted」 is **false on `main` today**. ⛔ Not on trust — the three readings above.

## ⚠️ Site 7, half 2 — the trap, and it is a REAL one

「Deleting the read would have … reddened its pin」 is a **counterfactual about a tree that no longer exists**. objectui#6557's pin is `packages/app-shell/src/views/ObjectView.titleFieldConvergence.test.tsx` — and objectui#9052 **edited that very file**: its docblock now reads 「the seam count below dropped from seven to six」 and a `describe` now reads 「the middle rung is gone (objectui#6557)」.

⇒ ⛔ **Running that pin on `main` proves nothing about the clause.** Green there is green on a pin that was rewritten to expect the removal. The honest re-derivation is at **`2f6b2bf1a^`** — the pre-merge base — with the rung removed and the pin *unedited*. That is the measurement the reviewer claims to have taken (32/32), and this card says in its own words: ⛔ 「the second row is a claim about a *measurement someone else took*, which is exactly the kind this card exists to catch.」

## Premises — ⛔ each is yours to re-run

| reading | value on `fac5acfa4` |
|:--|--:|
| all seven files present in `.changeset/` | **7 / 7** |
| `.changeset/*.md` entries | **1395** (card: 1363 · triage: 1381) |
| open PRs in repo | **10**, one of which is objectui#5400 |
| objectui#5400 state | **open**, head `e4ce4f4`, base `8b7ea39`, 1147 files |
| objectui#9052 merge commit | `2f6b2bf1a` |
